name: The Great Forge
about: Anvildeep's Great Forge: the cavern floor around the furnace, a hall of pillars with the Great Forge glowing at the north end. The Thane's seat and war-table, the Great Anvil, the open Heart Vault with its empty plinth, the rune-wardens' gallery, the Hushed post, Dagna's half-cold side forge and the cog-cage lift down to the Deep.

exits.label: the stair back up to Copper Row

actors.name: Forge-Thane Ragna Copperbraid
say: A Midgarder in my hall. Sit, or stand. Don't touch the anvil.

actors.name: Rune-warden Sereth Gloamweave
say: Rune-warden Sereth. I keep the cold lights. Mind the lens, it bites. Not literally. Mostly.
Dwarves make the fire. We make the runes that hold it. Nobody writes songs about the runes.

actors.name: Captain Ilvar Hushblade
say: Ilvar. Captain of the Hushed. We guard the Thane quietly. You're very loud.

actors.name: One of the Hushed
say: (The Hushed say nothing. You can feel them listening.)

actors.name: One of the Hushed
say: (The Hushed say nothing. You can feel them listening.)

actors.name: Dagna Coalbeard
say: Hm. A Midgarder. Stand back from the hot bit.

actors.name: Anvildeep dwarf
say: Soot in my porridge again. Soot in everything. Soot is the dwarf seasoning.
